note:
staging takes 1.4.5. One release is crossed, 1.4.4 to 1.4.5, and nothing is
skipped, so no skipped release carries a landing section anybody has to read.

The releases: class fix, disruption quiet. No core floor moves. Codex stays at
0.147.0 and Claude stays at 2.1.227, the same values 1.4.4 declared.

The box, measured on staging at 14:41Z before this note was written:
claw-members holds one person, that person's persistent core is installed and
reads 2.1.227, which meets the floor. No member reads as below a floor, so this
claw's own classifier will not defer the release to the quiet window.

A claw carrying its own skills in the machine-wide tier now passes its apply.
1.4.4 is the release that did not: it shipped the fix that keeps those skills
and its own machine-path control then failed the run on every claw that had one,
so the apply converged the bytes and reported a failure, the carried version was
not advanced, and no changelog entry was written. That control now reads the
tier three times and passes on a delta of one, whatever the tier already holds.

The line at the top of a ride names one channel once. On a first-tier claw it
says the claw's own pointer carried the tag; on a lower tier it names the
channel it read. Only the wording changed, and a ride resolves the same tag from
the same channel it did before.
